sources.quote: BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).
APPROVAL AP-0311: part BR-220; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese); billet grade EN AW-6082-T6; status APPROVED 2026-07-20 (PPAP-2026-118, drawing Rev C)

findings.why: The ASL covers BR-220 at TO1 for STL and lists only Alluminio B (Settimo Torinese) as approved. Termica Nord S.r.l. is the proposed new homogenisation site. It has no approval for this part, plant and customer, and approval is per supplier location. Moving the process there is not covered by AP-0311.
